The document checklist and the fee table extracted with broken letter spacing; values were used only where the label and the amount were unambiguous on the same line [A01].
The text on the temporary-license page gives a combined XM total that does not match the XM fee in the fee table on the following page, so no XM total is taught [A05] (verify TN-APP-D-XMFEE).
The fee table carries a marked footnote about National Guard and military family members whose marker attachment is unclear in extracted text; it is taught only as a limit on the active-duty extension that the same page describes [A06] (verify TN-APP-D-GUARD).
Fees, payment methods, websites and mailing addresses are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic; fee values are taught only from the table and flagged dynamic.
